source: ProtoTrack indexes (sets, named gear, named weapons, exotics, gear talents, weapon talents, prototype stats) checked 2026-11-01, cross-checked against the Division 2 Community Data Hub CSVs (https://github.com/div2hub/game-data, CC BY 4.0), which ProtoTrack cites for base weapon stats and attribute caps. shd.gg was behind Cloudflare and was not fetched. Numbers are stored only where one of those sources states them.

items.name: Acosta's Go-Bag
items.talent: One in Hand .../...Two in the Bag
items.talentText:
One in Hand ...
Throwing a grenade refunds it and grants +1 skill tier for 15s.
Grants overcharge if already at skill tier 6.
Cooldown: 60s
... Two in the Bag
+1 Armor Kit Capacity
+3 Grenade Capacity
+25% Ammo Capacity
+10% Repair-skills
+10% Status Effects

items.name: Acosta's Kneepads
items.talentText: +20% Movement Speed.

items.name: Beacon
items.talentText:
Both you and Allies receive +30% Critical Hit Damage, +15% Skill Efficiency and +2% Armor Regen when an Ally is within 10m of you.
Receive +15% Critical Hit Damage, +8% Skill Efficiency and +1% Armor Regen when one of your Skills is within 10m of you.
Only the highest group of buffs can be active at one time.

items.name: Birdie's Quick Fix Pack
items.talentText:
+80% Revive Speed
-50% Weakened Debuff timer
+45% Hive Efficiency
Provides +50% Damage Resistance to both agents while reviving or being revived, and for 5s after a successful Hive Revive, or 10s after a Manual Revive.
Any successful revives provide +1 Skill Tier for 5s.
Revives at Skill Tier 6 grant Overcharge for 15s.

items.name: Blacklisters
items.talentText:
Shooting an enemy applies a mark.
Only one mark can be active at a time.
The mark disappears after 15s, or when the marked enemy dies.
Receive 600% Amplified Damage from the marked enemy.
Deal 30% Amplified Damage to unmarked enemies.
If only one enemy remains in combat, the mark disappears and cannot be reapplied.

items.name: Bloody Knuckles
items.talentText:
Damaging an enemy with a grenade or striking an enemy with a melee attack activates Seeing Red
Seeing Red grants +25% weapon damage and +100% to melee damage.
Seeing Red lasts 20 seconds and has a 60 second cooldown after completion.
While in cooldown, damaging an enemy with a melee attack or hitting an enemy with the effect of a grenade will complete the cooldown instantly.

items.name: BTSU Datagloves
items.talentText:
Grants +15% Hive skill haste per skill tier.
Detonating a Hive refreshes your skill cooldowns and grants overcharge for 15s.
If at Skill Tier 6, this effect also applies to all allies.
Allies receiving this effect are unable to benefit from it again for 120s.

items.name: Catharsis
items.talentText:
Taking damage builds stacks to a cap of 30.
Each stack grants 1.5% Weapon Damage.
Taking damage at max stacks triggers a purge, removing all stacks and Status Effects and then dropping a healing cloud which restores 5% of Max Armor for 10s to all allies in the cloud.

items.name: Centurion's Scabbard
items.talentText:
Swapping weapons will give the following groups of bonuses one by one, in order:
1. +20% Rate of Fire, +20% Weapon Damage
2. +50% Magazine Size, +50% Reload Speed
The bonuses remain active for 12s or until the next weapon swap.
Swapping to your sidearm will not trigger the next group of bonuses.

items.name: Collector
items.talentText:
+3 Grenade Capacity
+50% Grenade Radius
+35% Grenade Damage
+25% Grenade Damage for each extra enemy caught in the blast.
Automatically regenerate a grenade every 30s, if you have less than 2 grenades in your inventory.

items.name: Coyote's Mask
items.talentText:
You and all allies gain a bonus based on the distance of the last enemy you hit.
0-15m: +25% critical hit damage
15-25m: +10% critical hit damage and +10% critical hit chance
25m+: +25% critical hit chance

items.name: Dodge City Gunslinger's Holster
items.talentText:
While your pistol is holstered, gain a stacking buff every 0.3s, up to 100.
When you swap to it, your first shot consumes the buff and deals +10% damage per stack.
This deals headshot damage to anywhere you hit.
REQUIRES
Pistol Equipped

items.name: Exodus Gloves
items.talentText:
On Armor break, drop a Smoke Bomb at your feet, concealing you from enemies for 3s.
Cooldown: 40s

items.name: Harrier Pride
items.talentText:
Getting kills and hitting enemies 3 times builds Red stacks.
Each stack provides 0.5% Weapon Damage.
Getting hit 3 times builds Blue stacks.
Each stack provides 0.5% Damage Resistance.
Upon reaching 80 stacks in total, lose all stacks and receive a separate bonus of 0.5% Damage Resistance per Red stack and 0.5% Weapon Damage per Blue stack until the next time the stack cap is reached.

items.name: Imperial Dynasty
items.talentText:
While in combat, applies burn to the enemy closest to you within 20m.
Cooldown: 35s

items.name: Investor
items.talentText:
Receive bonuses for each non-Core Attribute on this item, depending on their color:
Red: +10% Critical Hit Damage
Yellow: +5% Skill Efficiency
Blue: +1% Armor Regen
This item can feature any Core Attribute.
This item features a third random Attribute instead of having a Gear Mod Slot.
This item cannot feature the Headshot Damage, Health or Skill Repair Attributes.

items.name: Iron Will
items.talentText:
Your next body shot will be considered a headshot.
Cooldown: 2s
REQUIRES
Equipped: Marksman Rifle, Rifle or Pistol

items.name: Memento
items.talentText:
Enemies you kill drop a trophy on death.
Collecting trophies provides both a short and long term buff, the first of which scales with the number of core attributes equipped, and lasts 10s.
Red - +5% Weapon Damage
Blue - +10% Bonus Armor
Yellow - +5% Skill Efficiency
For every trophy collected, gain an additional +1% weapon damage, +1% skill efficiency, and +0.1% armor regeneration for 300s.
Maximum 30 stacks.

items.name: Nimble Holster
items.talentText:
Receive repairs of 5% of your Total Armor for every 1m run in cover-to-cover.
Damage taken while doing a cover-to-cover is healed over 10s.

items.name: NinjaBike Messenger Backpack
items.talentText:
Slots in with any equipped Gear Set and or Brand Set item to fulfill a requirement towards unlocking a Gear Sets bonus.
Can unlock bonuses from multiple sets simultaneously.

items.name: NinjaBike Messenger Kneepads
items.talentText: Performing a cover to cover or vaulting reloads your drawn weapon and grants +25% bonus armor for 5s.

items.name: Nurse's Kneepads
items.talentText: Both you and Allies within 10m of you receive +40% Hazard Protection.

items.name: Overdogs
items.talentText:
Amplifies Weapon Damage by 30% to the lowest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy.
Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder
Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator.
Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy

items.name: Provocator
items.talentText: Receive +25% Damage Resistance from enemies within 20m.

items.name: Ridgeway's Pride
items.talentText:
Shooting enemies within 15m applies bleed to the target.
Repair 3-48% of your armor per second for every enemy that is bleeding within 15m.
Repair strength per number of bleeding enemies:
1:3% 2:6% 3:12% 4:24% 5:48%

items.name: Rugged Gauntlets
items.talentText: +50% Weapon Handling.

items.name: Sarru
items.talentText:
While in combat, the Moon will cycle through its phases every 5s. There are 8 Moon phases.
Starting from a New Moon, all damage you deal will be Amplified by 5%. The value of the Amplifier will increase by 5% each phase until reaching 25% during a Full Moon, then it will decrease as the Moon returns to being a New Moon, restarting the cycle.
During a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for 10s.

items.name: Sawyer's Kneepads
items.talentText:
Cannot be staggered by explosions.
Increases total weapon damage by 3% each second you are not moving.
Stacks up to 10 until you start moving.
All stacks lost 10s after moving.

items.name: Shocker Punch
items.talentText:
While Shocker Punch is equipped, the stun received by the agent from the Shock status effect will be reduced by 50%.
Using a shield will give 100% to melee damage.
Using St. Elmo's Engine with the holster will give 100% extra melee damage and will make the next melee attack to apply Shock to the target.
Using all three items will offer all of the above mentioned bonuses and the Shock from the melee attack will have a 5m radius, starting from the first target.
15 seconds cooldown.

items.name: Tardigrade Armor System
items.talentText:
Whenever your or any ally's armor breaks, they gain 80% of your armor as bonus armor for 10s.
Cooldown per ally: 45s
Killing an enemy with your specialization weapon removes this cooldown for all allies.

items.name: The Catalyst
items.talentText:
Catalysis
Dealing and receiving status effects (Burn, Bleed, Shock, EMP/Disrupt, Poison, and Blind/Disorient) builds stacks of Catalysis to a maximum of 12. Each stack grants:
+2% weapon damage
+2% status effects
Each enemy within 25 meters that is affected by a status effect grants +1 stack/sec.
Being affected by status effects grants +2 stacks/sec.
Stacks decay at 1 stack/sec after 5s if no enemies in the radius or you are affected by status effects.
Reactant
At max stacks, killing a status-affected enemy grants bonuses for 5s:
+25% bonus armor
+20% reload speed
Stabilizer
While burning, you can maintain ADS without disruption.

items.name: Tinkerer
items.talentText:
If your Primary and Secondary weapons are not Exotic or Named and of the same type, the Secondary Weapon's talent will also be applied to the Primary Weapon.
Does not apply if the Primary or Secondary Weapon's Talent includes weapon swapping.
Does not apply if the Primary and Secondary Weapons' Talents are the same.

items.name: Vile
items.talentText:
Status effects also apply a damage over time debuff for 10s.
Total damage dealt is equal to 50% of your concussion grenade damage and increased by your status effect attributes.

items.name: Waveform
items.talentText:
Generate a stack of 3% skill damage on one of your skills every second, capping at 10 stacks.
After 10 seconds at the cap the stacks transfer to your other skill.
The process then repeats ad-infinitum.

items.name: Agitator
items.talentText:
While this weapon is holstered, generate 50% less Threat when shooting.
Keeping this weapon holstered for 10s will prime it.
While primed, swapping to this weapon grants +25% Rate of Fire, +30% Weapon Damage and you generate 100% more Threat when shooting for 20s.
Swapping from this weapon before the timer ends removes the bonuses.

items.name: Backfire
items.talentText:
Dealing damage to enemies adds a stack of +2% critical hit damage, up to 100 stacks, lasting 10s.
On reload apply a 10s bleed to yourself, which deals 0.5% armor damage per stack.

items.name: Big Alejandro
items.talentText:
Every bullet fired while in cover increases Weapon Damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15s. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration.
The bonus damage is cancelled by reloading. swapping weapons or exiting combat.

items.name: Bittersweet
items.talentText:
Hitting headshots builds stacks, up to a max of 8.
When shooting an Ally or Skill, repair them for 50% of the weapon's Total Damage value for each stack.
Healed Allies will receive 50% of your Repair Skills bonus as Bonus Armor for each stack for 10s.
All hits are guaranteed headshots for 8s after healing an Ally or Skill while at maximum stacks.

items.name: Bluescreen
items.talentText:
Shooting an enemy marks that enemy and adds a stack to the agent up to a count of 50. Shooting a marked enemy refreshes the mark and adds stacks to the agent.
When you deploy a non- shield skill, remove all stacks on agent and all marked targets trigger an effect.
1 - 10 Stacks - Pulse marked targets for 5 seconds
11 - 25 Stacks - Pulse and Disrupt marked targets for 5 seconds.
26 - 49 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets for 5 seconds.
50 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets and all hostiles within 10 meters of the marked targets for 5 seconds. This effect will trigger immediately if any marked enemy is killed.

items.name: Bullet King
items.talentText:
This weapon never needs to be reloaded.
For every 100 bullets that hit an enemy, replenish some ammo to you and your allies' reserves.

items.name: Busy Little Bee
items.talentText:
Each shot to a different target will give 1 stack, up to 10, each stack will give 20% weapon damage increase.
Stacks will activate once the agent switches weapons and will last for 10 seconds.

items.name: Caduceus
items.talentText: Critical hits repair you and your allies for 3% of the hit's dealt damage.

items.name: Capacitor
items.talentText:
Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. After 5 seconds, stacks decay 1 per second.
For each skill tier gain 7.5% weapon damage.

items.name: Chameleon
items.talentText:
Hitting 30 headshots grants +20% critical hit chance and +50% critical hit damage for 45s.
Hitting 65 body shots grants +90% weapon damage for 45s.
Hitting 20 leg shots grants +150% reload speed for 45s.
Buffs refresh when out of combat.

items.name: Diamondback
items.talentText:
Diamondback randomly marks an enemy within 20m. If no enemies are within 20m, it marks the enemy closest to you.
Hitting that enemy consumes the mark, guaranteeing a critical hit with damage amplified by 20%
After hitting a mark, all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 5s.
A new random enemy is marked afterwards and whenever you reload.

items.name: Doctor Home
items.talentText:
Shooting an enemy with this weapon will apply a mark for 5 seconds.
If a marked target is killed it will give a 50% Armor repair kit which applies to the whole party. The Kit will not give bonus armor.

items.name: Dread Edict
items.talentText:
Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 20. Headshots grant 2 stacks. Each stack grants 2% Weapon Damage and 5% Headshot Damage.
On reload, clear all stacks and gain 5% of your max armor as temp armor for 10 seconds for each stack removed.
Headshot kills with Dread Edict restore all bullets in the magazine. This does not count as a reload.

items.name: Eagle Bearer
items.talentText:
Eagle's Strike
Accuracy increases as you continuously fire, up to +30%.
Headshot kills grant the Tenacity buff for 15s.
The strength of Tenacity is increased by 1% for body shots and 5% for headshots.
Tenacity
40-80% of damage taken is delayed until the buff expires.
All of the total delayed damage is reduced for each enemy killed while the buff is active, up to 100% with 3 kills.

items.name: Fafnir
items.talentText:
This weapon fires Dragon's Breath shells. Each shot has a 40% chance of applying Burn to the enemy. An enemy cannot be applied Burn if they are burning already.
Weapon Damage is Amplified by 50% of your Status Effects bonus.

items.name: Iron Lung
items.talentText:
Shooting heats up the weapon, filling up heat meter. The meter is equivalent to 50% of the weapon's standard Magazine Size.
When the meter is full, rounds shot by the weapon ignite enemies.
When not shooting, the meter depletes over time. Reloading or swapping the weapon fully depletes the meter.

items.name: Lady Death
items.talentText:
When moving, gain 4 stacks per second, or 8 stacks if sprinting. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size.
Each round fired consumes a stack, amplifying damage by 75%.
Kills grant +20% movement speed for 10s.

items.name: Liberty
items.talentText:
Hits grant +2% weapon damage. Stacks up to 30 times.
Headshots consume all stacks, repairing your shield for 3% per stack.

items.name: Lullaby
items.talentText:
Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies.
Cooldown: 15s.

items.name: Mantis
items.talentText:
Your scoped view displays additional information about enemies not targeting you. Headshot and weakpoint damage against enemies not targeting you amplified by 65%.
Headshot kills reset the cooldown of the Decoy skill. This bonus will wait until the Decoy goes on cooldown if currently active.

items.name: Merciless
items.talentText:
This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack.
At 7 stacks, shooting an enemy deals +500% amplified damage and creates a 7m explosion dealing 500% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

items.name: Mosquito
items.talentText:
Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players.
At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor.
Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

items.name: Nemesis
items.base: Custom AWM AICS 2.0 chasis AX50 stock Magpul AFG-12
items.talentText: Shots fired deal 0-100% weapon damage based on how long the trigger is held before releasing.

items.name: Ouroboros
items.talentText: When the agent has a Status Effect applied to them, 50% of the ammo in their next magazine will apply the same Status Effect to their targets. This effect will only occur during combat.

items.name: Overlord
items.talentText: Hitting an enemy applies -4% Movement Speed for each pellet hit for 5 seconds. Shooting the enemy again will reapply the stacks.

items.name: Oxpecker
items.talentText:
While having a Shield deployed, lose Shield Health at a rate of 10% per second.
Your Shield receives repairs of 25% of the damage dealt by this weapon.

items.name: Pakhan
items.talentText: Each kill with this weapon gains a stack of 75% Base Magazine Size increase to the next magazine, up to 4 stacks.

items.name: Pestilence
items.talentText:
Hits apply a debuff dealing 100% weapon damage over 10s. This stacks up to 50 times.
Whenever an enemy dies with this debuff, 100% of the stacks are transferred to a nearby enemy within 25m.

items.name: Prima Donna
items.talent: You can look .../... but you can't touch
items.talentText:
You can look ...
When out of combat, receive 10 stacks. This weapon deals +11% Amplified Damage per stack.
... but you can't touch
1 stack is automatically consumed to fully repair one instance of damage you receive. 1 stack replenishes every 3s.

items.name: Regulus
items.talentText: Headshot kills create a 5m explosion, dealing 400% weapon damage and applying bleed to all enemies hit.

items.name: Ruthless
items.talentText:
This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack.
At 7 stacks, shooting an enemy deals +500% amplified damage and creates a 7m explosion dealing 500% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

items.name: Sacrum Imperium
items.talentText:
Tags enemies when in crosshair (maximum of 10)
If Agent kills any marked target with a headshot, all other targets will have 50% movement speed decreased and receive burn for 10 seconds.
Cooldown 30 seconds.
Killing another enemy with a headshot will shorten the cooldown for 10 seconds.
Targets are marked after 1 seconds in crosshair.

items.name: Scorpio
items.talentText:
Shooting a target applies stacks of venom, which last for 10s. Increasing stacks adds more severe debuffs to the target.
2 - Poison
4 - Disorient
6 - Shock
9 - Target takes additional 20% damage (from all sources). Stacks no longer increase.
Duration of Status Effects is based on percentage of pellets hit on applying shot.

items.name: Sheriff
items.talentText:
+35% Weapon Damage
+100% Accuracy
No Damage Drop Off.
These bonuses are built into the weapon's base stats.

items.name: Shroud
items.talentText:
Amplifies Weapon Damage by 125% to the highest ranking enemies currently in combat, as per the Tier hierarchy.
Tier 1: Hunter, Rogue, Leader, Tank, Shield, Heavy Weapons, RPG, Medic, Controller, Warhound, Marauder
Tier 2: Support, Engineer, Bodyguard, Immobilizer, Bomber, Mini Tank, Drone Operator
Tier 3: Any other enemy or skill proxy

items.name: St. Elmo's Engine
items.talentText: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will give 1 stack. At 100 stacks the next magazine will be 100% filled with shock ammo.

items.name: Steel & Sons ACR
items.talentText:
Body shots add 1 stack to the enemy for 10s. Max stacks: 4. Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks.
This weapon deals +4% Amplified Damage per stack.
Your next headshot on an enemy with stacks consumes all stacks, dealing +11% Amplified Damage per stack.
Destroying an enemy's weakpoint causes them to take +30% Amplifie Damage from you for 5s.

items.name: Strega
items.talentText:
Killing an enemy will apply a mark on every enemy within 20m of it. Multiple marks can be applied to the same enemy. Max number of marks that can be applied to an enemy is 5.
All marks on an enemy will disappear 10s after the last one has been applied.
Deal +15% Amplified Damage per mark to marked enemies.

items.name: Sweet Dreams
items.talentText:
Melee attacks instantly kill non-elite enemies.
Cooldown: 15s.

items.name: Tempest
items.talentText: Deal 25% Amplified Damage for 20s after your Shield gets broken.

items.name: The Bighorn
items.talentText:
When scoped, switches to semi-automatic fire mode, dealing 450% weapon damage with each shot.
Headshots grant +6% headshot damage. Stacks up to 25 times.
Once at full stacks, 10 stacks decay every 4 seconds until all stacks have been removed. Headshots delay decaying of stacks.

items.name: The Chatterbox
items.talentText:
When you reload, rate of fire is increased by 25% for each enemy within 15m for the duration of that magazine. Max stacks: 5
Kills refill 50% of your magazine.

items.name: The Ravenous
items.talentText:
On trigger-pull, fire both barrels at once.
When fired from the right shoulder, hits add offensive primers, and defensive primers when fired from the left shoulder. Hits from one shoulder will detonate all of the opposite shoulder's primers when present.
When detonated, each offensive primer deals 100% weapon damage, while each defensive primer grants +4% bonus armor and +10% amplified damage to armor plates for 5s.
Primer effectiveness is doubled at 10 stacks.

items.name: Underboss
items.talentText:
Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark.
More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 4.
This weapon deals +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 5% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own.

items.name: Vertigo
items.talentText: Whenever this weapon makes an enemy Suppressed, the enemy is applied Disorient, and you and allies receive +30% Damage to Targets Out of Cover for 15s.

items.name: Vindicator
items.talentText:
While scoped, the weapon will highlight a random body section of each enemy.
The weapon amplifies damage by +60% Weapon Damage to highlighted body sections.

items.name: Whiplash
items.talentText:
Having this weapon holstered for 5s reloads and primes it.
While primed, swapping to this weapon reloads your Primary and Secondary weapons and grants +20% Rate of Fire and +50% Weapon Damage until its magazine is emptied.
Reloading or swapping from this weapon before its magazine is emptied will remove its stat bonuses.
